notes: One-command weekly refresh for the no-market FGS path.
FPLReview xMins are used as expected minutes; FPLReview Pts are discarded.
Understat non-penalty xG priors are used where matched; StatFootDB goals per90 remains fallback.
No bookmaker/sharp odds are used in this path; build the transcript/sharp-market path separately later.
Output includes AGS/FGS/LGS rows when returned by The Odds API.
Player prop outcomes do not include team in the observed payload; rows are initially duplicated to both fixture sides, then resolved against no-market player/team rows where available.
Pinnacle/Betfair/Matchbook/Smarkets may exist for h2h but can be absent for player-goalscorer prop markets.

method_notes: Transcript/sharp-market path: AGS odds are converted to implied probabilities and Poisson lambdas.
Player market lambdas are used as ratios, then normalized to PL model team expected goals after own-goal and substitute-goal shares.
This is separate from the no-market FGS path and should be compared, not mixed silently.
Manual CSV input only; no automated betting/order placement.

validation_summary.leakage_guard: prior player goals/minutes are cumulative sums shifted before current match
validation_summary.scope_note: Validates player prior AGS component only; upcoming team-xG normalization and FPLReview xMins are not historically replayed here.

historical_goals_summary.starter_proxy_definition: minutes >= 60; proxy only because current StatFootDB public lineup cache does not separate starting XI from bench robustly
